title: feat(formal): add zero-dependency Lean 4 Frontier 7000 ledger and universal rank-one fusion obstruction (no new \kappa)
body: This PR contributes `formal/lean/Frontier7000ZeroDeps.lean` (zero-dependency `leanprover/lean4:v4.21.0` `Init`-only module with zero axioms across all 5 theorems, checking Frontier 7000's `kappa`/BIT-supplier/rank-mass ledger and proving the general two-probe `rank_one_fusion_impossible` determinant obstruction instantiated on `#7493`) plus `docs/research/zero-deps-lean-frontier-and-batch-obstructions.md` (`no new \kappa`, zero overlap with `PRChecksA`–`PRChecksC`).
